network.previous_missing.text: A packet from player {from} on channel {channel} showed that the packet before it, sequence {sequence}, had not arrived; recovered from the copy it carried: {recovered}; {drops} losses were counted on that link (-1 when it had no slot)

network.queue_full_gap_skipped.text: The receive queue was full with nothing in order to deliver; packet {sequence} from player {from} (entry {peer}, channel {channel}), whose gap had {retries} resend requests, was delivered past the expected {expected}; {queued} packets queued

network.ready_changed.text: Player {player}'s ready flag became {ready} at roster place {index} (place 8: not in the roster)

network.ready_roster.text: The host's ready roster arrived: {players} players listed and {needed} more wanted

network.receive_drained.text: DirectPlay handed over no more packets for now; {queued} packets were queued

network.receive_queue_full.text: The receive queue is full at {queued} packets; only packets from the host are kept, and receiving stops until the next pump

network.receive_stalled.text: The receive queue held {queued} packets and none could be handed to the game, not even one past a gap

network.recovery_needed.text: Flight history or message capacity or continuity was exceeded; state recovery is needed

network.refresh_requested.text: The player asked for a fresh list of games
